page.overview:
What is Hylian Shield?

It is the traditional Shield borne by the Knights of Hyrule and is commonly used by Link in 3D Zelda games and spin-offs alongside the Master Sword since its first appearance in , making the Hylian Shield itself a signature image for the hero like the sacred blade. Unlike the less advanced Wooden Shields, the Hylian Shield will not burn upon contact with fire. Though it is made of steel, it is light and sturdy, an optimal weight for a fighter with a one-handed weapon.

Throughout , the Hylian Shield has had minimal differences to its overall design, always bearing the symbol of the Triforce and a red Hylian Crest below it that represents the goddess Hylia and the Crimson Loftwing that helped Link at the founding of Hyrule. The first Hylian Shield was a legendary shield guarded by the Thunder Dragon Lanayru, who created the Lightning Round to judge whether someone would be worthy of wielding the Shield, in . Although this shield is an important defensive item for Link, it is surpassed by the Mirror Shield in some games.

While the Hylian Shield does not exist in nor its DX version (though technically did debut by the latter's release), it was given an appearance for the Nintendo Switch remake of the game. It can be received from Tarin after Link wakes up on Koholint Island.

In its debut in the long-running series, the Hylian Shield can either be purchased or found by Link as a child in . Emblazoned with Hylian artwork, complete with a Crimson Loftwing and the Triforce, the Hylian Shield is far too large for Child Link to wield on his arm unlike the Deku Shield and functions more like a turtle's shell. After his seven year sleep and becoming the Hero of Time, Link can use it as his standard Shield. The Hylian Shield is later surpassed by the Mirror Shield, which is only usable by Adult Link as this particular shield is even larger in comparison.
